item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong direct 2024 evidence that Abiy’s economic team was using crony appointments or overt patronage to run macro policy; the public record is dominated by IMF/NBE/World Bank reform documentation. I also did not find firm 2024 FDI or private-investment outcome data proving that the reforms had already restored investor confidence by year-end. So the best-supported reading is: strong reform intent and real policy action, but mixed execution because inflation, FX shock, debt distress, and internal conflict still weighed heavily on stability and investment.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF Executive Board Approves Four-Year US$3.4 billion Extended Credit Facility Arrangement for Ethiopia","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr","summary":"The IMF said the program was meant to address macroeconomic imbalances, restore external debt sustainability, eliminate monetary financing of deficits, tighten monetary policy, mobilize revenue, and strengthen SOE finances.
